text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's first three years
have finally reached their conclusion—

As she is "now," she stands at the center of the era,
shaping the very forefront of history.

And her stride, as long as she has beloved rivals,
will go on endlessly.

Within the tracks left by her hooves,
people will surely see a mighty river of brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Would you mind keeping me company for a moment?

The moment she appeared on our day off, Mejiro Ardan
stared straight at me and suddenly blurted that out...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That's a secret.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I have a car waiting outside,
so please come out once you're ready,
Trainer.

Not quite understanding what was happening,
I hurriedly prepared to head out
and decided to accompany Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"—No matter when you come, the view here is wonderful,
and it's such a calming place."

The car driven by Mejiro Ardan's nanny
brought us to a hill near the Mejiro family's retreat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Do you remember where this is?
choice_data_list: This is where I showed you the roadmap.
This is where I showed you the roadmap, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In the place where Trainer
first showed me a 'future'—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It is the origin of who I am "right now."

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
Milady. Everything is prepared,
so I shall lay it out here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you, nanny.
choice_data_list: What the hell are you doing?
What on earth are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Would you allow me to paint a portrait
of you right here, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's a painting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Walking this path alongside you over these past three years,
I have received so many things from you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Every single one is a precious memory, not a single drop I'd ever want to spill...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I started wanting to leave behind
a tangible record of the time I spend with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And what came to mind then... was the drawing I used to do while I was in the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"That feeling I had back then,
when Trainer showed me
what the future could be."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And my feelings here in the "now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I want to capture that in a painting,
right here in this place."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please... would you listen
to my selfish request?
choice_data_list: Should I just strike a pose for now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: May I draw it?

To cherish what Mejiro Ardan
wants to do most "right now."

That... is one of the things I committed myself to
over the past three years.
Why on earth would I turn it down now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how many times those words
have encouraged me up to this day...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —...gh, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here,
why don't you try drawing something too, Trainer?

Afterward, the two of us drew portraits of each other
and exchanged the finished drawings.

The portrait Mejiro Ardan drew of me was so beautiful
and mystical, it was hard to believe it was really me—
On the other hand, Mejiro Ardan even went so far as to say she would frame the drawing I had poured my heart into...
Before long, the place turned into a lively chat reminiscing about these past three years, and before we knew it, the sun was already sinking low—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Am I... etched within you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Unchanged ever since the time we talked here back then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Does my 'future'
exist within you?"
And a "future" certainly exists as well.

Now, and in the future, for as long as I live.
Mejiro Ardan will forever remain engraved within me.

"And even if I'm gone,
the luminous trail left by Mejiro Ardan's running
will surely be passed down to future generations."
"Yes, to me, Mejiro Ardan has always been—"
choice_data_list: To me, you are an "eternal" radiance.
To me, you're an everlasting radiance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That would be unfair.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Because then... I'd be the only one left to live on forever...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I won't accept something like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall engrave
Trainer's "present" and "future."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Just like you did
for me, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As long as I draw breath,
I will continue to carve out your "future."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"If I, who am eternity to you,
continue to engrave your 'now' and 'future'—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It must surely be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Because it will become an “eternity” that belongs only to us.
